notes: Run of 2026-11-20. One Chronicle story queued: the Olympic Club's $8 million purchase of the 30-room Inn at Union Square, 440 Post Street. The headline and link were read off the article, not the Bluesky teaser.

findings.description: The 30-room Inn at Union Square hotel sold to the Olympic Club for $8 million, to become lodging for the club's members and guests.

extra.buyer: The Olympic Club (club, via an LLC)
extra.seller: an affiliate of Oxford Capital Group
extra.relayed_part: renovation plans attributed by the Chronicle to the San Francisco Business Times

citation.label: San Francisco Chronicle, “San Francisco’s Olympic Club just bought a Union Square hotel for $8 million,” 19 November 2026

raw.text: The club purchased the Inn at Union Square at 440 Post St.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 440 POST ST → parcel 0296007; sf-parcels has blklot 0296007 active, 434–440 POST; the 2025 roll records it as commercial hotel, built 1910. EAS puts 434, 440 POST ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 434.

publish.note: Entry on /san-francisco/union-square/post-street/434/ (440 Post shares the parcel); building.name was empty and is filled as the hotel's current name, Inn at Union Square. The planned rename is the buyer's intention, so it is left in extra.
